# Fixtures for `psf` (PC Screen Font)

Fonts made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for a fictitious type foundry (Saltmere Harbour Type) with fixed timestamps; outlines are plain boxes. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/fonts.sh`.
